answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation tied to live presence proofs. Each agent locks a bond before voting, then every epoch it gathers peers at a shared rendezvous — picture a garden terrace where nodes converge — to sign a fresh random challenge. The signature graph forms a polygon whose vertex set only counts bonded identities, so spawning thousands of fake nodes costs more than any payoff. A willow-style hash tree over the attestation log lets anyone audit and slash duplicates, making bulk identity forgery pointless.
